subject: Finlytics POC - success criteria & timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@finlytics.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@finlytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Finlytics POC - success criteria & timeline

Hi Sara & Rajiv —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the POC kickoff: 

High-level POC goals (draft success criteria)
- Functional: Redwood answers core Finlytics prompts with >= 95% relevance on the sample test set (we'll provide the test prompts).
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 600ms for 512-token responses under the agreed load profile.
- Throughput: sustain 8 concurrent sessions at target latency for 15-minute bursts.
- Cost proxy: projected token cost < $X per 1M tokens (we'll run a baseline run).
- Security: model runs in our VPC with audit logs enabled; no customer PII persisted beyond KV cache TTL.

Evaluation plan (proposal)
1) Week 0 (this week): agree on success criteria and test prompts; share sample dataset or S3 path.
2) Week 1: SE (Dev) runs baseline runs in staging; share initial metrics and logs.
3) Week 2: iterate on prompts/quantization and run full evaluation; handoff to CS for UX touches.

Ownership
- Redwood sales (me) — commercial touchpoints and timelines.
- Dev Patel (SE) — run the test harness, produce metrics and troubleshooting.
- Evelyn Hart (CS) — onboarding, monitoring, and ops checks.

Attachments: POC_Success_Criteria_and_Timeline.xlsx, Test_Prompts_v1.txt (draft).

Ask: Please confirm the success criteria above and share a sample dataset or S3 read-only creds (or let us know if you prefer a secure upload link). Also confirm target POC window (we're proposing Mar 8–22).

I'll follow up with a brief calendar invite for a kickoff sync once we have confirmation.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@finlytics.com>

Date: 2026-03-02T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finlytics POC - success criteria & timeline

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary — this looks good overall. A couple quick notes from our side: 

- We're comfortable with the functional and latency targets, but can we relax the latency SLO to 700ms 95p if that makes the initial setup faster? We can tighten after the first iteration.
- For throughput, our realistic concurrent load for evaluation will likely be closer to 5 sessions; we can start there and ramp if needed.
- Attached our internal requirements doc (Finlytics_Requirements.pdf) — includes data retention expectations and SOC 2 references. Can you confirm Redwood's retention policy for KV cache and audit logs?

We'll provision a small sample dataset (anonymized) and aim to share by EOD Thurs (Mar 5). If there are any minimum file format constraints let us know; otherwise we'll drop a zipped CSV on S3.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.

Cheers,
Sara
Sara Thompson | Product Lead, Finlytics

Marissa / Evelyn —

Thanks — I'm drafting the eval playbook and can run an initial baseline on our staging cluster. Quick tech notes / asks: 

- I'll use the Test_Prompts_v1.txt as the baseline. If Finlytics can provide 200–500 sample rows (CSV) with the input/query column that'd be ideal.
- Preferred upload methods: (1) pre-signed S3 link to staging bucket, or (2) secure SFTP. We cannot accept plaintext PII; please ensure the sample is anonymized per your note.
- For retention: we will enable audit logs and set KV cache TTL to 24 hours for the POC unless you request otherwise. Audit logs will be retained in the customer's control plane for 30 days (we can extend if needed under an agreement).

Proposed evaluation tasks & timeline tweaks:
- Mar 5: receive dataset and access method.
- Mar 8: full environment verification and small smoke runs.
- Mar 10–12: baseline runs and metric collection.
- Mar 15–18: iterate on prompts/quantization; second measurement pass.

I'll attach the eval playbook (eval_playbook.md) with the commands and expected outputs. Please confirm the dataset upload method and whether we should expect an IAM role or a pre-signed link.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
